configuration: Evaluate the masked k-space data-fidelity gradient and the forward/adjoint total-variation transforms on a deterministic 32x32 Shepp-Logan fixture.
observable: Image-grid data-fidelity gradient, two TV coefficient fields, and TV-adjoint image.
default_vs_upstream: The upstream random TV fixture is replaced by a deterministic phantom of the same kind used by setup_method; shapes and source routines are unchanged.
variant: The phantom amplitude is increased by two binary64 ulps, perturbing every active FFT and TV stream.
altbuild: none: the source is pure Python/NumPy and the image supplies no second numerical build.

evidence.floor_how: Same pinned Python/NumPy implementation rerun deterministically; no legitimate alternate build is available.

warrant: Each array position is a physical image pixel or directional finite-difference coefficient. A missing sampling mask, FFT adjoint, or TV difference changes many pixels above 1e-10, while the deterministic NumPy FFT and fixed difference stencils permit small cross-platform roundoff under 1e-7 relative error.
